name: ICU Medical
outlook:
What ICU Medical says to expect

  • Full year 2026: guidance statusThe Company is reaffirming its full year 2026 guidance but expects to end the fiscal year towards the higher end of the guidance range.
  • Full year 2026: GAAP net income and earningsThe Company's previously provided full year GAAP net income remains estimated to be in the range of $73 million to $83 million and GAAP diluted earnings per share to be in the range of $2.89 to $3.29.
  • Full year 2026: adjusted EBITDA and earningsThe Company's previously provided full year 2026 guidance of Adjusted EBITDA remains estimated to be in the range of $415 million to $435 million and adjusted diluted earnings per share to be in the range of $8.60 to $9.00.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 5, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
